svg.title: Why a subject vocabulary standard
svg.desc: A shared core of abilities, such as Traceability, that every repository can use in front-matter subject. Each repository adds its own themes and components beneath them, or replaces the core with its own set, so work from many repositories rolls up under the same promises.
